reason: Background-command callbacks. (1) The callback result was projected into provider history as an invalid nebula.tool-result/v2 dict, so the model saw the pre-v2 omission notice; the webhook now stores posted stdout/output as tool-call artifacts in the same transaction as the execution, and chat materializes a valid bounded v2 receipt with artifact references (failed callbacks as failed receipts; the missing-callback envelope now names its call and captured output). (2) The results API key no longer enters any durable row or model/UI payload: the broker's waiting receipt omits it, turns park on results_url + process_id, ToolResultReceipt never keeps it, and the turn ledger (rows and pre-ledger tool_history, read and write) and the generic tool-call API scrub it from rows recorded earlier. (3) Captured stdout/stderr are linked when results arrive before the process exits. (4) The results webhook reads at most 1 MiB, refuses output over 64 KiB of JSON, keeps posted output only in artifacts and answers with a small acknowledgement. Selection: the callback journey end to end (test_process_results_webhook: webhook route, accept, resume through provider admission, next provider request, tool_output.read, failed and missing callbacks, key never durable, legacy-row scrub via ledger/API/replay, late output linkage, body/output bounds); the runtime whose accept/finalize paths changed and whose fake backend now records env (test_automation_runtime); callback reconciliation after restart (test_restart_recovery_lifecycle); receipts and the tool loop that replays them (test_chat_tool_loop, test_tool_failures, test_in_turn_context_pruning, test_turn_prompt_cache); the pending-callback turn API; the chat and API nodes that build or recover v2 receipts; generic CRUD reads and the OpenAPI contract (test_api nodes).
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. No UI, Playwright, native or frontend code changed, so those layers are empty; the tool card's technical details and artifact list read the same scrubbed receipts through existing code. Only the receipt-related nodes of the large test_chat.py and test_api.py files are selected. tests/v3/test_automation_runtime.py::test_host_scope_expiry_closes_running_commands is timing-sensitive: it failed locally in file order under load average ~10 on both this branch and pristine origin/main c273ea2, and passes on both at normal load. The callback, missing-callback, key and late-output journeys were also exercised against a scratch Core with a real OpenRouter model in host execution mode.
